_meta.description: Frozen Stage-1 + Stage-2 design for the detectability-aware post-merger GW anomaly screening project. Loaded exactly by Notebook5_Final_TestBlock_Evaluation.ipynb -- no threshold, model, hyperparameter, or preprocessing choice in that notebook may be changed based on test_block results.

stage1.note: Threshold value confirmed identical across two independent re-derivations (Notebook 4 and Notebook 4.5).

stage2_primary.description: Nonlinear damped-sinusoid least-squares fit (scipy.optimize.curve_fit) on the whitened time-domain window.

stage2_secondary.description: Time-frequency ridge/energy-decay fit on band-restricted CQT frame power, adaptive noise-floor-truncated fit window. No further tuning permitted (frozen as of Notebook 4.5).

power_baseline.description: Logistic regression on total_power_raw (in-band CQT power, [1500,4000]Hz) alone, fit on stage2_calib only.
power_baseline.decision_rule: flag anomalous if predicted P(anomalous) > operating_threshold_probability
power_baseline.interpretation: weaker and direction-sensitive, not uninformative -- do not report AUC(power) alone; always pair with the operating-point TPR/FPR
power_baseline.note: Regression coefficients are not hardcoded here (never persisted as raw numbers); re-derived deterministically from stage2_calib in Notebook 5 and the resulting operating threshold is asserted to match the value above.

explanatory_only_not_load_bearing.band_leakage_diagnostic: Inconclusive (Notebook 4.5 Sec. 8) -- narrow/full-passband power ratio does not cleanly separate by tau. Must not be used to justify, adjust, or interpret any threshold above.

rules: test_block may only be loaded in Notebook5_Final_TestBlock_Evaluation.ipynb.
No threshold, model, hyperparameter, or preprocessing choice may be changed based on test_block results.
No further ridge estimator tuning is permitted.
If test_block performance is worse than the stage2_val held-out validation, report it honestly -- do not tune to close the gap.
